stages.label: History
stages.text: 19-year-old soccer player, non-contact pivoting injury three weeks ago, immediate swelling. Wants to return to competitive soccer.

stages.label: Imaging report
stages.text: Complete ACL tear. No meniscal tear that needs repair. Bone bruising typical of the mechanism.

stages.label: Exam
stages.text: Positive Lachman and pivot shift. Full range of motion, quadriceps activation good.

guideline.note: Illustrative: structured rehabilitation first, with reconstruction if instability persists, is a supported option.

attending.note: Illustrative: early reconstruction for a pivoting athlete who wants to return.
